edges.reason: msg.sender must equal the deposit token address before a deposit is recorded.
msg.sender is the identity credited with the claimed virtual balance.
msg.sender indexes depositorBalance during migration.
msg.sender indexes virtualBalance during migration.
msg.sender indexes depositorBalance during withdrawal.
onlyManager compares manager against msg.sender.
block.timestamp used to derive depositEndTime and withdrawUnlockTime.
block.timestamp is compared with depositEndTime to gate deposits.
block.timestamp is compared with withdrawUnlockTime to gate withdrawals.
onlyManager restricts setMigrationContract to the manager.
onlyManager restricts setMerkleRoot to the manager.
setMerkleRoot delegates to the internal _setMerkleRoot routine.
claimVirtualBalance delegates to the internal _claim routine.
_setMerkleRoot writes the merkleRoot state variable.
_claim reads merkleRoot for proof verification.
_claim reads and sets the claimed bitmap to prevent double claims.
virtualBalance[msg.sender] += amount after claim verification.
depositorBalance[from] += amount on ERC777 deposit.
depositorBalance[msg.sender] -= amount during migration.
depositorBalance[msg.sender] -= amount during withdrawal.
virtual balance update writes the virtualBalance mapping.
depositor balance update writes the depositorBalance mapping.
withdraw performs an external depositToken.transfer after updating state.
migrateDeposit performs an external call after decrementing the balance.
migrateVirtualBalance performs an external call after decrementing the balance.
setMigrationContract performs an external call to getMigratorAddress().
setMigrationContract performs an external approve call on the deposit token.
ERC777 token transfer invokes the recipient tokensReceived hook.
migration contract can re-enter migrateDeposit on this contract.
migration contract can re-enter migrateVirtualBalance on this contract.

the computed leaf is used for merkle proof verification.
